bookings_during_valid.name: bookings_during_valid
bookings_during_valid.value: NOT isempty("bookings"."during") AND NOT lower_inf("bookings"."during") AND NOT upper_inf("bookings"."during") AND lower_inc("bookings"."during") AND NOT upper_inc("bookings"."during")

space_blocks_during_valid.name: space_blocks_during_valid
space_blocks_during_valid.value: NOT isempty("space_blocks"."during") AND NOT lower_inf("space_blocks"."during") AND NOT upper_inf("space_blocks"."during") AND lower_inc("space_blocks"."during") AND NOT upper_inc("space_blocks"."during")

branches_cover_photo_alt_length.name: branches_cover_photo_alt_length
branches_cover_photo_alt_length.value: "branches"."cover_photo_alt" is null or char_length("branches"."cover_photo_alt") between 1 and 120

chat_rooms_kind_ref.name: chat_rooms_kind_ref
chat_rooms_kind_ref.value: ("chat_rooms"."kind" <> 'booking' OR "chat_rooms"."booking_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("chat_rooms"."kind" <> 'channel' OR "chat_rooms"."floor_id" IS NOT NULL) AND ("chat_rooms"."kind" <> 'team' OR "chat_rooms"."team_id" IS NOT NULL)

team_invites_one_pending.name: team_invites_one_pending
team_invites_one_pending.where: "team_invites"."email" is not null and "team_invites"."accepted_at" is null and "team_invites"."declined_at" is null and "team_invites"."revoked_at" is null
